answer: A delta freight exchange can stop agents using cheap keys to forge a favorable position in its routing network. For each planning horizon, close enrollment before an unpredictable public seed appears, then derive every node position from that seed and a unique paid admission ticket. Tickets are nonrefundable and each fixes one position for the period. Generating new keys cannot supply free placements near a targeted price feed. This raises the cost of surrounding it, but wealthy attackers can still buy many tickets and the seed must resist manipulation.
